definitions.explanation: The money paid periodically for the use of rented property, especially land or buildings. A more formal, contractual term than {家賃|やちん}.

examples.japanese: {賃料|ちんりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{賃料|ちんりょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十|じゅう}{万|まん}→十万：30469_juuman⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧だ。
⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき、{賃料|ちんりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When the contract was renewed, the rent was raised.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{賃|ちん}→〜賃：28343_chin⟧ (fee, wages) + ⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧ (charge). Common in contracts and law.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {賃料|ちんりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧: to pay rent
- {賃料|ちんりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧: rent increase
- {賃料|ちんりょう}⟦{相場|そうば}→相場：07668_souba⟧: market rent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧: rent — the everyday word, used mainly for housing
- {地代|ちだい}: land rent — specifically for renting land
- {賃料|ちんりょう} is broader and more formal, covering both land and buildings.
